> **Beta software.** Subsonic Hi-Fi NAVI-AZ95 is in beta and may contain bugs. It needs a Subsonic-compatible server (Navidrome) or an Icecast/AzuraCast stream for radio. The software is provided **as is**, without warranty of any kind.

Install: put `xenu.subsonic-{version}.zip` in your RetroXR data folder under `mods/` (`~/retroxr/mods/` on desktop).
